children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Prepare a Kubernetes cluster, choose secure chart values, deploy Gameplane, bootstrap access, and verify the control plane before hosting servers.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Save the exact chart version and rendered values used for every environment. They are part of your recovery plan.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Start with a supported Kubernetes and Helm version, ready nodes, DNS, and a default or explicitly selected StorageClass.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Plan namespaces, ingress, TLS, and load-balancer behavior before install.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Reserve capacity for the API, operator, agents, backup jobs, and workloads.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Install cert-manager only when your certificate flow depends on it.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Set external URL, ingress and TLS, storage, authentication, cluster operations, telemetry (on by default from v0.4.0), and update policy deliberately.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Keep secrets outside committed values files and reference Kubernetes Secrets.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Verify OIDC redirect URLs and preserve a local administrative recovery path.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Review defaults for every environment instead of reusing production values blindly.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Deploy the pinned OCI chart, bootstrap the first administrator, then validate pods, CRDs, dashboard access, and a test reconciliation.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  kubectl -n gameplane-system get pods && kubectl get crds

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Log in, select the cluster, and reconcile one test server
